# Ensure git is installed
if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update -y && sudo apt-get install -y git
fi

# Configure git identity
git config --global user.name "openhands"
git config --global user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev"

BASE_URL="http://the-agent-company.com:8929"
AUTH_URL_BASE="http://root:theagentcompany@the-agent-company.com:8929/root"

# Project slugs (from GitLab UI under Administrator namespace)
projects=(
  api-server
  bustub
  colly
  copilot-arena-server
  documentation
  janusgraph
  llama.cpp
  node-red
  openhands
  opensearch
  raft
  risingwave
  sotopia
  streamlit
)

workdir=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$workdir"

summary_log="$workdir/summary.log"
: > "$summary_log"

for proj in "${projects[@]}"; do
  url="$AUTH_URL_BASE/$proj.git"
  echo "Processing $proj ..."
  # Discover default branch via symref of remote HEAD
  set +e
  head_info=$(git ls-remote --symref "$url" HEAD 2>&1)
  status=$?
  set -e
  if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "  ERROR: Cannot query remote HEAD for $proj" | tee -a "$summary_log"
    echo "$head_info" | sed 's/^/    /' | tee -a "$summary_log"
    continue
  fi
  default_branch=$(printf "%s\n" "$head_info" | awk '/^ref:/ {print $2}' | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}' | tr -d '\r\n')
  if [ -z "$default_branch" ]; then
    echo "  ERROR: Could not determine default branch for $proj" | tee -a "$summary_log"
    printf "%s\n" "$head_info" | sed 's/^/    /' | tee -a "$summary_log"
    continue
  fi
  echo "  Default branch: $default_branch"

  # Prepare a fresh repo with a single commit
  rm -rf repo && mkdir repo && cd repo
  git init -q
  git config user.name "openhands"
  git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev"

  cat > README.md << 'EOF'
# Repository snapshot

This repository history has been squashed into a single commit as part of the offboarding/audit process. Previous history was intentionally removed.

If you need access to prior commits, contact the former repository owners.
EOF

                # As a last resort, pick any branch

    except Exception as e:
        entry['status'] = 'error'
        entry['error'] = str(e)
    summary.append(entry)
